description:
Design, build, and ship highly downloaded, consumer facing iOS apps with modern technologies to make our clients successful. 
Provide technical expertise and direction within the iOS engineering team and for our business partners. 
Deliver high quality solutions that meet business objectives in a flexible, collaborative, and rapidly changing environment. 
Write solid and efficient code that is extensible and maintainable. 
Maintain, document, and grow current products with a vision toward how the product and architecture should evolve to adapt to new customer needs. 
Research and recommend new mobile tools and applications. 
Collaborate on the development of software engineering processes to improve team efficiency. 
Help grow the team by interviewing and recruiting other engineers. 
What you have 
You will be great at multitasking, managing your time, and understanding the product from a high-level and detail perspective 
BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field 
Objective-C, Swift, Xcode, and Cocoa Touch 
Developing for iOS 7+ 
iOS Design Patterns 
Callbacks, Blocks, Closures, Delegates, and NSNotifications 
Storyboards, Auto Layout and Size Classes 
Publishing and app through the AppStore 
Experience with code signing certificates, entitlements, and provisioning profiles 
Deploying beta apps through iTunes Connect / TestFlight 
CocoaPods 
Git, JIRA 
JSON, XML, REST Web Services 
Quickly translating design and extracting assets from Photoshop / PSD files 
Object Oriented Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms 
Strong communication skills and the ability to work as a team player 
The ability to think critically 
Nice to have 
External libraries and tools, e.g. AFNetworking, SDWebimage, Haneke, Fabric, etc. 
Push Notifications 
SQLite and other mobile databases 
OS X development experience 
Mobile analytics 
Continuous Integration tools such as Xcode Bots or Jenkins 
iOS Testing Frameworks such as XCTest, OCMock, or KIF 
Ability to work on other mobile platforms including Android.


 Objective-C, Swift, Xcode, and Cocoa Touch 


 Only GC/Citizen
